title: Space/set: role hierarchy on member role assignment
description:
Spec jmap-chat-spec 061a30f (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Space/set, §Permission resolution):
(1) addMembers: 'Members may only assign roles whose position is strictly less than their own highest-position role; servers MUST enforce this.' updateMembers: 'Members may only add or remove roles whose position is strictly less than their own highest-position role; servers MUST enforce this.' Role hierarchy enforcement now covers 'role assignment through addMembers and updateMembers'.
Code: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/backend.rs:1330 contract table lists the hierarchy check only for AddRole/UpdateRole; MemoryBackend (memory.rs ~1262-1273, ~2166) enforces only those. A manage_members holder can grant a role at/above their own position via addMembers/updateMembers (privilege escalation). Change: extend the contract table + MemoryBackend to AddMember roleIds and UpdateMember role adds/removes -> Forbidden with 'hierarchy'/'position' in description; tests quoting 061a30f.
(2) Last-admin protection: 'The same protection applies to an updateMembers role change, a removeRoles entry, or an updateRoles permission change ...; a refusal names the patch key concerned.' Code: backend.rs:1331 contract always uses properties ['removeMembers']. Change: InvalidProperties naming the patch key that caused it (removeMembers / updateMembers / removeRoles / updateRoles); update contract doc + MemoryBackend + tests.
(3) Space/join: 'unless the invite specifies otherwise' removed — already compliant (SpaceInvite has no roles); verify docs don't claim invite roles.
Freeze-relevant: changes the documented ChatBackend::apply_space_patch contract (no signature change).
close_reason: Batch 8c: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at 860a4c2a
